## BindTarget  (type-only)
type BindTarget = HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement | {
    value: string;
    checked?: boolean;
    type?: string;
    addEventListener?: (type: string, fn: () => void) => void;
    removeEventListener?: (type: string, fn: () => void) => void;
};

## ImportResult  (type-only)
type ImportResult = {
    ok: true;
    migrated: boolean;
} | {
    ok: false;
    error: string;
};

## Infer  (type-only)
type Infer<S> = S extends Schema<infer T> ? T : never;

## Journal  (type-only)
interface Journal {
    push(label?: string): void;
    undo(): boolean;
    redo(): boolean;
    readonly canUndo: boolean;
    readonly canRedo: boolean;
    readonly length: number;
    readonly undoLabel: string | undefined;
    readonly redoLabel: string | undefined;
    clear(): void;
}

## JournalOptions  (type-only)
interface JournalOptions {
    limit?: number;
}

## LoadResult  (type-only)
type LoadResult = 'fresh' | 'loaded' | 'migrated' | 'recovered';

## MemoryStorage
class MemoryStorage implements StorageLike {
    get length(): number;
    key(index: number): string | null;
    getItem(key: string): string | null;
    setItem(key: string, value: string): void;
    removeItem(key: string): void;
    clear(): void;
}

## Migration  (type-only)
type Migration = (data: any) => unknown;

## MigrationError
class MigrationError extends Error {
    readonly fromVersion: number;
    readonly toVersion: number;
    constructor(message: string, fromVersion: number, toVersion: number);
}

## Migrations  (type-only)
type Migrations = Readonly<Record<number, Migration>>;

## NumberOptions  (type-only)
interface NumberOptions {
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    int?: boolean;
}

## SaveStatus  (type-only)
interface SaveStatus {
    persistent: boolean;
    loadResult: LoadResult;
    error: string | null;
    dirty: boolean;
}

## SaveStore  (type-only)
interface SaveStore<T> {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly persistent: boolean;
    readonly status: Readonly<SaveStatus>;
    readonly savedAt: number;
    get(): T;
    set(data: T): boolean;
    update(fn: (draft: T) => T | undefined): boolean;
    flush(): boolean;
    reset(): void;
    clear(): void;
    exportString(): string;
    importString(text: string): ImportResult;
    subscribe(fn: (status: Readonly<SaveStatus>) => void): () => void;
    dispose(): void;
}

## SaveStoreOptions  (type-only)
interface SaveStoreOptions<T> {
    game: string;
    slot?: string;
    version: number;
    migrations?: Migrations;
    defaults: () => T;
    schema: Schema<T> | ((value: unknown) => value is T);
    debounceMs?: number;
    host?: Pick<Host, 'storage'>;
    storage?: StorageLike | null;
    autoFlush?: boolean;
    now?: () => number;
    meta?: (data: T) => SlotMeta;
}

## Schema  (type-only)
interface Schema<T> {
    validate(value: unknown, path?: string): string | null;
    is(value: unknown): value is T;
    readonly _type?: T;
}

## SettingsStore  (type-only)
interface SettingsStore<T> extends SaveStore<T> {
    bind<K extends keyof T & string>(input: BindTarget, key: K): () => void;
}

## SettingsStoreOptions  (type-only)
interface SettingsStoreOptions<T> extends Omit<SaveStoreOptions<T>, 'slot' | 'debounceMs' | 'version' | 'meta'> {
    slot?: string;
    version?: number;
}

    thumbnail?: string;

## SlotManager  (type-only)
interface SlotManager<T> {
    readonly slots: number;
    list(): SlotInfo[];
    open(slot: number): SaveStore<T>;
    copy(from: number, to: number): boolean;
    remove(slot: number): void;
    rename(slot: number, label: string): boolean;
    mostRecent(): SlotInfo | null;
}

interface SlotManagerOptions<T> {
    game: string;
    version: number;
    migrations?: Migrations;

## StorageLike  (type-only)
interface StorageLike {
    getItem(key: string): string | null;
    setItem(key: string, value: string): void;
    removeItem(key: string): void;
    readonly length: number;
    key(index: number): string | null;
}

## StoredMeta  (type-only)

}

## TypedArrayOf  (type-only)
type TypedArrayOf<K extends TypedKind> = K extends 'u8' ? Uint8Array : K extends 'u16' ? Uint16Array : K extends 'u32' ? Uint32Array : K extends 'i8' ? Int8Array : K extends 'i16' ? Int16Array : K extends 'i32' ? Int32Array : K extends 'f32' ? Float32Array : Float64Array;

## TypedKind  (type-only)
type TypedKind = 'u8' | 'u16' | 'u32' | 'i8' | 'i16' | 'i32' | 'f32' | 'f64';

## s
const s: {
    unknown(): Schema<unknown>;
    boolean(): Schema<boolean>;
    string(opts?: {
        maxLength?: number;
    }): Schema<string>;
    number(opts?: NumberOptions): Schema<number>;
    literal<const L extends string | number | boolean | null>(...values: L[]): Schema<L>;
    array<T>(item: Schema<T>, opts?: {
        maxLength?: number;
    }): Schema<T[]>;
    record<T>(value: Schema<T>): Schema<Record<string, T>>;
    object<S extends Shape>(shape: S, opts?: {
        strict?: boolean;
    }): Schema<ObjectOf<S>>;
    optional<T>(inner: Schema<T>): OptionalSchema<T>;
    nullable<T>(inner: Schema<T>): Schema<T | null>;
    bytes(opts?: {
        maxLength?: number;
    }): Schema<Uint8Array>;
    typed<K extends TypedKind>(kind: K, opts?: {
        maxLength?: number;
    }): Schema<TypedArrayOf<K>>;
    union<T extends Schema<unknown>[]>(...options: T): Schema<Infer<T[number]>>;
};
